concerns.text: FR-005 mandates a one-way ANOVA reporting F-statistic and p-value; T006 replaces it with MixedLM and a binomial GLM. Additionally, "binomial GLM with the same random-effects structure" is not implementable (statsmodels.GLM has no random effects), and the contract's anova_accuracy block (F, df_between/df_within, arcsine-sqrt) does not match logistic output. The task silently weakens/contradicts the FR and the schema it claims to satisfy.

Spec requires each participant evaluate every snippet under ALL three conditions (fully within-subject, FR-008 "balanced within-subject design"); T004 implements a Latin-Square where "each participant sees each snippet once." These are contradictory designs; the task relaxes FR-008 rather than implementing it.

FR-004 requires "newly measured human evaluation data... from the user study," but no task conducts the user study (recruitment, task administration, response collection). T004 only merges a pre-existing human_study_responses.csv and fails if absent — the FR's data has no producing task.

T007 computes correlations for both source- and human-reference variants (4 metrics × 2 references × 3 outcomes = 24 tests) but applies Bonferroni at α = 0.05/12, and the schema's metric enum has no reference-variant field, so "every metric-outcome combination appears exactly once" cannot hold for 24 results. Correction denominator and schema consistency must be fixed.
SC-006 requires completeness "logged in dataset_preparation.log"; T001 produces no such log artifact. The acceptance criterion is silently dropped.

T002 consumes data/validated_snippets.jsonl "(after the validation pass producing...)" but no task produces that file — T001 writes raw_snippets.jsonl with valid records already, conflating raw and validated stages. The dependency T002 relies on is orphaned.
Plan specifies statsmodels.stats.power.FTestPower; T005 specifies FTestAnovaPower. Different classes/interfaces — one artifact is wrong; align them.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T006 verification vs spec.md:US-3 Independent Test
concerns.text: US-3's independent test requires the synthetic N=30 check to verify "power ≥ 0.80"; T006's pytest only asserts p < 0.05. Partially dropped acceptance criterion.

Constitution Principle I (NON-NEGOTIABLE reproducibility) requires re-runs to reproduce results, but T002 specifies no pinned decoding parameters (temperature=0 or seed) for the HF Inference API calls; llm_comment values and all downstream metrics will differ per run. Specify deterministic decoding or document the limitation explicitly.
